items.title: Qwenputer: A functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
items.reason: A real, working RISC-V CPU compiled directly into Qwen3.5-4B's weights (no training) — passes official riscv-tests, ran 18M instructions error-free, scores 97.5% vs base's 72.5% on DeepMind div_big. 97.5% on DeepMind div_big (base Qwen: 72.5%), 100% on NUPA long-integer arithmetic (base: 48.6%)
Code: github.com/divagr18/qwenputer; weights on HF/ModelScope; needs single 24GB GPU, ~3,200 tok/s on an L4
